analysis.coverage: Full duration at overview density; timestamps approximate.

concept.observed: A brand film cutting between black-and-white archival imagery (snowflake photographs, motion-study photographs, engravings, sculpture, a sunflower spiral) with thin construction lines, serif words with an accent question mark or full stop, and a closing mark and line.
concept.interpreted: Positions a product as a thinking tool by association with the history of inquiry.

palette.observed: Measured white #f8f8f8 (86%), greys, one terracotta accent #d87858 (1%); luma 0.94.

typography.observed: Serif lowercase words with accent punctuation.

composition.observed: Single centred cut-outs on white; vertical frame.

texture_and_effects.observed: Halftone and engraving textures from the source images; sculpture faces sliced into offset vertical strips.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Cuts at 0.75 and 1.20 s, soft change 2.81 s, cut 10.72 s; static hold 13.19-14.31 s; 7.1 onsets/s.

audio_and_sync.observed: All 3 boundaries within 50 ms of an onset (chance 51%); high spectral centroid (2.4 kHz).
audio_and_sync.interpreted: Percussive, bright track with cuts on hits; only four boundaries, so weak evidence.

motifs.observed: Spirals and construction lines; the accent mark.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -14.3 LUFS, LRA 1.8 LU, true peak -0.9 dBTP. 21 accents (87.1 a minute, the densest of the 14 after the 15 s grid reel). Accents on cuts 0.33 against chance 0.25 (3 boundaries); onsets near boundaries 1.00 against 0.51. Silence 14.14-14.49 s at the end; head +3.2 dB (a loud start). Listen sheet: nearly every accent brings a new archival image or word: a question mark (0.56 s), a snowflake in a ring (1.11 s), a proportion figure (1.53 s), a word (2.41 s), a snowflake grid (3.39 s), anatomy plates (4.25, 4.50 s), a word that changes letters (5.22-5.87 s), a vessel (8.34 s) and the closing word (10.80 s).
sound_design.interpreted: A montage cut to the sound, one image per accent every 0.4-0.9 s; the analyser's 3 boundaries undercount the soft image swaps.

narration.observed: 1 word in 1 phrase (12.8-14.0 s) over the end card; no speaker on any phrase frame; 1-2 word 'phrases' are dictation noise over the music. Verdict: none.

captions.observed: None; copy is centred lowercase serif words with one accent-colour letter or dot; no caption lane.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 3 boundaries (1 cut, 2 grow, 0 cover, 0 continuous). 0.75 s grow: the question mark's hook retracts into its dot (0.59-0.69 s), the dot becomes a stroke that draws a circle (0.72-0.93 s) and an engraving appears inside it. 2.81 s cut: the collage page to a hand-with-pen engraving on a clean change between 2.79 and 2.82 s; an orange ring draws on it. 10.72 s grow: a spiral winds into a dot (10.56-10.62 s), the dot becomes an asterisk, one inverted black frame (10.69 s), then the asterisk shrinks back to a dot that becomes the dot of the next word as it smears in (10.72-10.89 s).
transitions.interpreted: The orange dot is the hinge: it opens the film's two section turns. The detector finds 3 boundaries in 14.5 s; the collage also changes in place between them (overview).

Rapid archive images with line overlays and single words.
Closing line and mark; final hold.
